description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Image_Graph_Layout_Vertical' for managing a vertical layout in a graph rendering utility. It extends 'Image_Graph_Layout_Horizontal' and provides methods for splitting layout areas vertically based on percentages or absolute sizes. The file includes dependency on another layout class and documents its purpose within a graph visualization library.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Vertical
classes.description: A layout class for arranging elements vertically, splitting the container into top and bottom sections based on a percentage or absolute size.

methods.name: _getAbsolute
methods.description: Calculates the absolute pixel size for either the top or bottom part of the layout based on auto sizes and container height.

methods.name: _split
methods.description: Divides the layout into two parts using a specified percentage or default auto sizes.
